title: Subjects acutely Infected with Chikungunya Virus
description: A systems biology approach was used to analyze the blood transcriptomes of adults acutely infected with Chikungunya Virus. There were identified gene signatures and pathways that were associated to viral RNA amounts and to the onset of symptoms that characterize the adults’ acute infection.
